title: The member import's code is part of every first download of the admin app
what: The import of members from Excel or CSV (column matching, AI matching, branches, ID scrubbing, saving: about 3,000 lines) is loaded up front with the rest of the admin app, although a gym uses it about once. Only the spreadsheet reader itself is fetched later. Desk staff and trainers on a slow phone connection pay for it on every first open. The admin app has no speed score (it needs a login), so the real seconds are not measured.
expected: The import screen and its rules download only when someone opens Import members.
who: everyone who opens the admin app
how_often: every first open of the admin app
fix_line: Load the import screen only when it is opened, like the spreadsheet reader already is

title: Filling in missing details for members already in the gym saves one member at a time
what: When an owner imports a sheet again and chooses to fill in blank details of existing members, each member is saved separately and the next waits for the last. New members go 500 per save, but these go one by one, so a gym with 500 existing members waits for 500 trips to the server in a row; on a slow phone connection that is minutes with the import screen open.
expected: Existing members' blanks are filled in a few large saves, like new members are, so the import finishes in seconds.
fix_line: Send the fill-in changes in batches instead of one member per save

title: Each mobile number another desk added meanwhile makes the import resend up to 500 rows
what: If a member with the same mobile was added by someone else while the import runs, the whole batch of up to 500 is refused, one row is taken out, and the whole batch is sent again. Several such numbers in one batch mean several full resends.
expected: One refused number costs one small retry, not a full resend of the batch each time.
who: owners importing while the desk adds members
fix_line: Have the server skip mobiles already in the gym and report them, in one pass
